name: saleae-real-analyzers-long
experiment:
name: saleae-real-analyzers-long
duration: 90s

devices:
  logic:
    plugin: saleae
    device: AABBCCDDEEFF0001
    requires: [DigitalCapture]
    digital_channels: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    digital_sample_rate: 4000000
    channel_names:
      "0": CH1
      "1": CH2
      "2": CH3
      "3": CH4
    analyzers:
      - type: uart
        label: uart-ch1
        channels: {rx: 0}
        settings: {"Bit Rate (Bits/s)": 9600}
      - type: i2c
        label: i2c-ch1-ch2
        channels: {sda: 0, scl: 1}

plots:
  - name: overview
    title: Saleae real capture with analyzers
    format: svg

clock.source: Logic 2 capture time offset, anchored at host time of StartCapture RPC return
clock.note: Logic 2 buffers the capture and returns it after it ends; sample times are offsets from Logic 2's capture start, anchored at the host time the StartCapture RPC returned (RPC latency 537ms). The delay between that RPC and the device actually sampling is not measured, so no error bound is claimed.
